mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_nickname, c.customer_avatar as customer_avatar, a.agent_name as agent_name, a.agent_avatar as agent_avatar, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_review r LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON r.agent_id= a.agent_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON r.house_id = h.house_id WHERE r.review_id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_nickname, c.customer_avatar as customer_avatar FROM h_review r LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.transaction_id = #{transactionId}

SELECT r.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_nickname, c.customer_avatar as customer_avatar, a.agent_name as agent_name, a.agent_avatar as agent_avatar FROM h_review r LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON r.customer_id= c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON r.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE r.house_id = #{houseId} AND r.review_target_type = 1 AND r.review_is_show = 1 ORDER BY r.review_create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_nickname, c.customer_avatar as customer_avatar, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_review r LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON r.house_id = h.house_id WHERE r.agent_id = #{agentId} AND r.review_target_type = 2 AND r.review_is_show = 1 ORDER BY r.review_create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, a.agent_name as agent_name, a.agent_avatar as agent_avatar, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_review r LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON r.agent_id = a.agent_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON r.house_id= h.house_id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY r.review_create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_nickname, c.customer_avatar as customer_avatar, a.agent_name as agent_name, a.agent_avatar as agent_avatar FROM h_review r LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON r.customer_id= c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON r.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE r.review_is_show = 1 ORDER BY r.review_create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT AVG(r.review_rating) FROM h_review r WHERE r.agent_id= #{agentId} AND r.review_target_type = 2 AND r.review_is_show = 1
